personality_one_liner: A high-performance, dark-first institutional trading terminal prioritizing data density, rapid execution, and visual hierarchy over decorative elements.

spacing.rule: Dense but legible. Use smaller padding (sm/md) for data rows and tables, keeping hierarchy clear with typography rather than large spatial gaps.

dont's: No glassmorphism on dense data screens. Clarity and performance beat aesthetic in a trading terminal.

screens.name: Auth & Vault
screens.purpose: Local PIN and biometric unlock for HSM-encrypted keys, plus the setup form for multi-exchange API connections.

states.empty: No API keys configured. Illustration of a secure vault, 'Connect an Exchange to begin.'
states.error: Authentication failed or API Key invalid. Red alert banner with 'Retry' action.

screens.layout: A rigid, secure login pad centered on screen. Once unlocked, a list view of connected exchanges (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken) with their active/inactive status badges. Forms should use labels above inputs and robust error validations.

screens.name: Terminal Dashboard
screens.purpose: The primary command center showing aggregated Portfolio net worth, live P&L, and active bot fleet status.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for portfolio numbers and charts to avoid layout shift.
states.empty: No active bots. 'Deploy your first strategy' CTA.
states.error: Websocket disconnected. Yellow/Red sticky warning banner at top: 'Live Feed Interrupted - Reconnecting...'

screens.layout: Top section: High-impact condensed numbers for total balance and 24h P&L. Middle: Fleet comparison list using mobile-first cards for each bot (showing health bars, realized P&L, and current regime). Bottom: Activity timeline of recent automated executions.

screens.name: Strategy Config
screens.purpose: Detailed form to deploy or edit a trading strategy (Mean Reversion, Trend Following, Grid) with risk constraints.

states.loading: Spinner during backtest simulation or param save.
states.error: Invalid parameter combinations (e.g., Kelly sizing > 100%). Inline red text under inputs.

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable form. Segmented controls to select strategy type. Grouped input fields for Kelly Criterion sizing and max drawdown. A sticky 'Deploy Bot' CTA anchored at the bottom above the safe area.

screens.name: Market Screener
screens.purpose: Live market visualization, regime detection (Trending/Ranging), and LLM-powered sentiment analysis feed.

states.loading: Skeleton rows for order book and asset list.
states.error: Failed to fetch market data. 'Tap to reload' centered.

screens.layout: Swipeable tab layout (Chart, Order Book, Sentiment). The Order Book view uses dense rows with subtle depth visualization. The sentiment feed uses a chat/timeline list layout highlighting bullish/bearish tags via semantic colors.

screens.name: Trade Journal
screens.purpose: A chronological audit trail of all bot decisions, trades, and circuit breaker events.

states.empty: No trades executed yet. Muted text 'Awaiting bot execution...'
states.error: Failed to load history. 'Retry sync' CTA.

screens.layout: List-heavy view with subtle row separators (border color at 30% opacity). Each row displays the pair, strategy name, P&L (semantic color), and a chevron to expand for detailed decision factors.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '7 Dark-First Utility DARK' personality rigidly. The UI must feel like an institutional trading terminal, not a playful fintech app.
Typography is critical: Use Rajdhani for all metrics, numbers, and high-impact headings. Use IBM Plex Sans for body text, labels, and forms. Cap font weight at 500 max.
Colors: NO BLUE, INDIGO, OR PURPLE ANYWHERE in the system UI. Rely on the #0B0E11 surface and #FF9F0A (Amber) brand accent. Semantic Red/Green are strictly for P&L and live status indicators.

When displaying Coinbase and Kraken entities, because their image selectors failed, use initials (CB and KR) enclosed in their real brand color backgrounds: #0052FF (Coinbase Blue) and #5741D9 (Kraken Purple). THIS IS THE ONLY PERMITTED USE OF BLUE/PURPLE, as it is a strict brand identity requirement.
Glassmorphism is disabled. Use solid surfaceSecondary (#141620) or surfaceTertiary (#1E202B) with 1pt borders (#2B3139) to separate hierarchy instead of shadows or blur.
For the Bot Dashboard, replace dense desktop tables with mobile-first card layouts. Use subtle row separators (divider token) for lists.
Ensure 'Sticky primary CTA over scrolling content' rule is applied for the 'Deploy Bot' button in the Strategy Config screen.
Implement wire haptic feedback for bot controls, tab changes, and parameter sliders (detailed in the haptics block).
Keep empty states professional with text or minimal Phosphor icons; avoid playful illustrations.
